# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU backend and Vulkan Silk.NET** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backend bindings and the Vulkan Silk.NET package. This preview adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Android and Linux Vulkan test coverage, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and fixes several native use-after-free and memory-leak bugs.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152** — The bundled Skia engine is upgraded to chrome/m152, with follow-up servicing syncs and stability fixes merged in during the preview. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal and Dawn** — Adds SkiaSharp bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend, covering Vulkan, Metal and Dawn, alongside a restored SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Android and Linux Vulkan test coverage. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain a RequestReadPixels API that works asynchronously across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Improved NuGet package READMEs** — The published NuGet package READMEs are refreshed with clearer content. ([#4714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4714))

## Bug Fixes

- **Several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes** — Fixes use-after-free crashes in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With*, an undisposed SKStreamAsset leak in HarfBuzz blob conversion, a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on SKImage.Create failure, and a missed Dispose of the previous uniform buffer in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset(). ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))
- **FreeType used for Nano Server font support** — Nano Server containers now resolve fonts through FreeType instead of failing due to missing platform font APIs. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Further managed performance ports and allocation reductions** — SKData.SaveTo, SKFourByteTag/Tag ToString, GetEncodedText, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookups all avoid extra copies, boxing, or allocations, and HandleDictionary's skip-registration check is cached — no observable behaviour change. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android builds** — Apple native symbol packages are generated during pack, Android builds run on Linux with a deterministic build identity requirement, and all solutions are converted to the newer .slnx format. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528), [#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612), [#4815](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4815), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Avoids a defensive Feature[] copy in Font.Shape and improves NuGet package documentation, alongside the bundled HarfBuzz update to 14.2.1.200.

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 opened the line with the Skia m152 update, Graphite GPU backend bindings, the restored Vulkan Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes.
